$comment: Byte ceilings for ORIENTATION documents — the ones read at the start of a session, whose size
is paid in context on every single run. Enforced by tests/doc-budgets.test.js.
This is the 'promote a rule into a lint' step (see CLAUDE.md > Working in this repository >
House rules and how they become checks). CLAUDE.md has been over the advisory 40 KB nudge for
some time and the nudge changed nothing, which is the case for a ceiling that fails instead.
TWO CATEGORIES, AND THE SPLIT IS THE WHOLE DESIGN.
orientation — a ceiling plus a ratchet. These files are read to get oriented, so their cost is
recurring. A file at or under `target` is healthy. A file above it is `grandfathered` at its
size when the rule was adopted: it may SHRINK freely and may NOT grow. That is what makes the
rule adoptable today on a corpus that already violates it — the alternative, a flat limit,
fails on day one and therefore never gets adopted at all.
exempt — append-only ledgers. A growth ceiling on these is simply WRONG: BUGS.md is supposed to
grow when a bug is found, and a check that fires on correct behaviour teaches people to ignore
checks. Their size is managed by ARCHIVING (/sig:docs-archive, /sig:docs-migrate eviction),
not by a limit. They are listed rather than merely absent so that the population test can tell
a deliberate exemption from a file nobody has considered.
exemptPatterns — per-unit work artifacts (an Epic's PLAN/PROGRESS/SUPPLY docs, a milestone spec,
a dated review snapshot). These are outputs of one piece of work, not things read to orient, and
enumerating them would add manifest churn to every Epic for no reader. Matched on basename.

CLAUDE.md.reason: De-bloated 2026-09-02: 51.4 KB -> 25.2 KB by removing per-release narrative duplicated from CHANGELOG.md and the retros. Now under target, so the grandfather flag is dropped and the ceiling is the target. The ratchet did its job — it failed the suite the moment the file shrank, which is how the improvement gets locked in rather than quietly re-spent.

.planning/CONTEXT.md.reason: Accumulates a dated 'where things stood' section per Epic and evicts none of them. The oldest are reachable from the retros.

.planning/STATE.md.reason: Carries inlined narrative alongside the authoritative frontmatter. Ratcheted 48659 -> 45836 on 2026-09-03 when M6.E5's closed-Epic narrative was evicted to RETROSPECTIVES.md at the M6.E6 open; shrinking re-tightens the ceiling, so the freed room is not silently re-granted.

README.md.reason: Within budget. Listed so it stays that way.

.planning/PROJECT.md.reason: The v1 spec, named in CLAUDE.md as orientation reading. Within budget; listed so it stays that way.

exempt..planning/BUGS.md: Append-only ledger. Growth on a new bug is correct behaviour; size is managed by archiving.
exempt..planning/DECISIONS.md: Append-only ledger — explicitly so; a reversal is a new entry, never an edit.
exempt..planning/BACKLOG.md: Append-only queue; rows are struck rather than deleted so provenance survives.
exempt..planning/INDEX.md: Generated by /sig:docs-index at every phase transition; its size is an output, not a choice.
exempt..planning/ISSUES-INBOX.md: Capture inbox, drained at PLAN; a stale-inbox check already covers it.
exempt..planning/STATE-HISTORY.md: Append-only history of STATE.md; its whole purpose is to accumulate.

exemptPatterns.reason: Per-unit Epic artifact (PLAN / PROGRESS / VERIFICATION / REVIEW / SUPPLY / RETROSPECTIVE). An output of one piece of work, not orientation reading.
Milestone specification — read when working that milestone, not at every session start.
Dated review snapshot; frozen once written.
